messages.text: BL-1715 🎵 in progress — In a stage with a Claude seat beside a local driver seat (the mixed pack's coder and coder@2), a parcel the local seat still fails after its last fix turn is recorded, given up and worked next by the Claude seat with no deferral - the local seat never takes that ticket again, its failed changes leave its tree, every local attempt (handed off, given up or escalated) leaves one outcome row, and a stage with only driver seats keeps BL-1697's escalate-and-hold
